items.followUp: State two functions of the nucleus.

rubric.why: Award for identifying the membrane’s role in enclosing, protecting, or separating the cell contents.
rubric.description: The cell membrane surrounds the cell and protects or separates its contents from the outside environment.
rubric.how: Look for the membrane surrounding the cell, or protecting or separating its contents.

rubric.why: Award for identifying the membrane’s role in controlling exchange with the environment.
rubric.description: The cell membrane selectively controls the movement of substances into and out of the cell.
rubric.how: Look for selective permeability or control of movement through the membrane.

modelAnswer: The cell membrane surrounds the cell and protects its contents, separating them from the outside environment.
It selectively controls the movement of substances into and out of the cell.
